name: Miyazawa Midori
source:
Midori is the ex-manager and one of the two people who resigned in protest from the soccer club when Sousuke was suspended and Takeda quit. As a result, she came to spend her days watching over the two practice along the riverbank. 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2009/10/01/natsu-no-ame-review/]Hau! Omochikaeri's review[/url].]
